name: Myra — AI Chat Widget
author: mecoprojects

sections.description:
Myra is an AI chatbot for WordPress — an AI assistant for your website. She replies to visitors in under a second, in 50+ languages, around the clock — answering questions, capturing names and phone numbers as leads, and booking appointments straight into your Google Calendar.

This plugin adds the Myra chat widget to your WordPress site with zero code:

  • One-minute install — paste the widget token from your Myra dashboard and save.
  • Always up to date — the widget loads from Myra’s servers, so every improvement ships automatically. The plugin itself never needs an update for new features.
  • Everything is managed in your Myra dashboard — colors, greeting, knowledge, language, behaviour. Changes apply to your site instantly.

What Myra does for your business

  • Instant replies, 24/7 — under a second, any hour
  • Captures every lead — name, phone, email pulled from the conversation
  • Books appointments into Google Calendar — free slots only, no clashes
  • Speaks 50+ languages — detects and replies natively
  • Telegram notifications the moment a lead arrives
  • Dashboard with every conversation, lead and stat

Don’t have an account? Start a 7-day free trial — no credit card required.

External services

This plugin embeds the Myra chat widget, which is loaded from and communicates with myrachat.com (the Myra SaaS platform). When the widget is active on your site:

  • The widget script is loaded from https://myrachat.com/widget.js.
  • Visitor chat messages are sent to myrachat.com to generate AI replies.
  • Contact details a visitor chooses to share in chat are stored in your Myra account as leads.

A Myra account is required (terms, privacy policy). The plugin sends no data anywhere until you save a widget token.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Create your assistant at myrachat.com (5 minutes, free trial).
  3. Copy the widget token from your Myra dashboard (Settings → Install widget).
  4. In WordPress, go to Settings → Myra Chat, paste the token, save. Done — the widget is live.
sections.faq:
Do I need to know how to code?

No. Paste one token into one field — that’s the whole setup.

Will I need to update the plugin when Myra improves?

No. The widget loads from Myra’s servers, so new features, languages and fixes appear on your site automatically. Plugin updates will be rare (only if WordPress itself changes how plugins should behave).

How is Myra priced?

The plugin is free. Myra subscriptions start at $19/month after a 7-day free trial (no credit card required to try). Billing happens in your Myra account at myrachat.com — WordPress is not involved in payments.

Does the widget slow my site down?

No — it’s one small script loaded asynchronously in the footer, after your content.

Where do I customize the widget?

In your Myra dashboard: color, position, greeting, avatar, languages, knowledge base, booking rules. Changes apply instantly without touching WordPress.
